title: csv_find_missing_comma
prompt:
Audit this CSV against the schema Name (text), Age (integer), City (non-empty text). Report only malformed source rows, using their physical line number and quoting the original row. Suggest the missing comma or field when the problem is unambiguous. Do not report valid rows or invent punctuation not present in the input.
Name,Age,City
Alice,30,London
Bob 25,Manchester
Carol,28,Bristol
Dave,31
Eve,27,Leeds
